test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electronic Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of shielding in electrical cables?

options.text: To protect the cable from external electromagnetic interference
To increase the current-carrying capacity of the cable
To increase the voltage capacity of the cable
To prevent heat loss from the cable

solution:
The **primary purpose of shielding in electrical cables** is: **1) To protect the cable from external electromagnetic interference**

**Explanation:**

**Cable shielding** (usually a metallic foil or braided conductor) is used to:

 
• 
 
Block **external electromagnetic interference (EMI)** from affecting signal quality

 
 
• 
 
Prevent the cable’s own signals from radiating and causing interference to nearby equipment

 
 
• 
 
Improve **signal integrity**, especially in communication and control cables
